asserted_claims: On the stated dense arithmetic domain, the exact avoidance-vector squared norm ratio is product_p_in_S (1+(1-p^(-t))^2/(p^s-1)); this diverges for 0<s<=1.
For s>1, the weighted integer realization has matrix B_(dh,h)=d^(-s/2) product_p_divides_d(1-p^(-t)) h^(-t), yielding the explicit ordinary trace zeta(t) for t>1.
The fixed gcd inner product gives unequal adjoint matrix elements already on u1 and u2, so the moment evolution is not selfadjoint.
difference: The source supplies a Markov semigroup and positive gcd feature states separately. This investigates their previously unproved compatibility in a fixed infinite Hilbert norm. It derives an explicit unboundedness witness rather than invoking generic finite-carrier, positive-cone or trace-normalization kills. The positive s>1 trace is retained and is not claimed to produce the signed Weil form or zeta-zero spectrum.
method: Explicit prime-avoidance test functions and exact tensor-product norms. Separately derive the s>1 weighted-L2 representation, boundedness, Hilbert-Schmidt and trace-class conditions and the ordinary zeta trace.
next_test: Independently audit the infinite norm and Schatten-class arguments, then specify any proposed metric-changing or native readout interface and test its preservation of full source operations, observation overlaps, boundary data and costs.
object: For fixed 0<s<=1 let H_s be the completion of span{u_n=n^(s/2)1_(n divides x)} in the profinite measure mu_s(n Zhat)=n^(-s), with Gram K_s(m,n)=gcd(m,n)^s/(mn)^(s/2). Test whether the moment semigroup T_t u_n=n^(-t)u_n admits a bounded extension on this same Hilbert space for fixed t>0. No metric, observation algebra or source changes are allowed.
obligations: Independent audit of the written infinite-dimensional argument before theorem promotion.
Derive a native interface, preserving the complete declared operations and source information.
Keep arithmetic state parameter s distinct from semigroup time t.
For factoring implement N-only state or jump preparation without a divisor-neighbor oracle and account for all costs.
For RH derive the exact full signed Weil trace, Gamma and pole terms, test domain and global positivity independently.
scope: Boundedness claim is refuted only for the fixed arithmetic gcd-feature Hilbert space with 0<s<=1 and t>0. Finite Markov kernels, normalized profinite measures, N-specific sampling, different Hilbert metrics and different operation contracts are not refuted. For s>1 the same semigroup is bounded; it is trace class exactly when t>1, with trace zeta(t). It is not symmetric in the stated gcd inner product. These are written own derivations with exact finite controls, not accepted Lean rules or external review.
stop_condition: Reject the fixed-metric bounded extension at 0<s<=1 once the prime-avoidance norm ratio diverges. Stop any RH promotion at the missing signed all-place Weil identity and independent positivity. Never reinterpret the s=1 or t=1/2 summability thresholds as the RH critical line.
